name: SubHunter & ffsubsync Aligner
author: OmniDesk
description: SubHD / ASSRT / custom subtitle search, secure <=16MB archive extraction with UTF-8 conversion, and ffsubsync VAD / linear subtitle synchronization.

config_schema.label: 默认字幕源
config_schema.description: Subtitle provider used by subtitle.fetch.v1 search when request.provider is omitted

config_schema.label: ASSRT API Token
config_schema.description: Stored exclusively in 0600 SecretVault (never written to plain config or logs)

config_schema.label: 字幕下载根目录
config_schema.description: Root directory where downloaded subtitles are safely written (defaults to plugin data directory when empty)

config_schema.label: 最大下载体积 (MB)
config_schema.description: Maximum allowed download and extracted archive size in MB (hard-capped at 16 MB)

config_schema.label: ffsubsync 可执行路径
config_schema.description: Executable name on PATH or absolute path to ffsubsync

config_schema.label: 字幕覆盖策略
config_schema.description: Default protect_manual refuses overwriting existing manual subtitles

config_schema.label: SubHD Base URL
config_schema.description: HTTPS base URL for SubHD search and detail requests

config_schema.label: ASSRT API Base URL
config_schema.description: HTTPS base URL for ASSRT v1 API

config_schema.label: 自定义字幕源 Base URL
config_schema.description: Optional HTTPS base URL for a user-configured subtitle provider

config_schema.label: 字幕站点 Cookie（可选）
config_schema.description: Optional Cookie fallback stored exclusively in 0600 SecretVault when web.cookies.v1 is absent

config_schema.label: 自定义字幕源 API Key（可选）
config_schema.description: Optional API key for custom provider stored exclusively in 0600 SecretVault
